evidence_note: Oqaatsit 1997 entry e11671 gives the exact Danish gloss ‘politiet’ for the plural-only Kalaallisut headword politiit. Katersat’s ‘politifolk’ remains an alternate lexical gloss from its separate source.

The Oqaatsit 1997 Danish entry records the finite phrase ‘søger oplysninger’; gloss_da is its normalized infinitive. Ordbogen 2003 independently pairs paasissutissarsiorpoq with søger ~er. The KNR parallel article is regression evidence only and is not the distributable gloss source.
